extDescription.message: Shows your tabs in the VIZEN app on this PC: switch to a tab, mute it, open it in its own window or mirror it live for capture. Nothing leaves your computer.

popupIntro.message: Your tabs appear in VIZEN (site name and title only; incognito tabs are never shared).

popupMirror.message: Mirror this tab live for VIZEN

popupMirrorHint.message: Opens a small window that shows this tab live, even when the tab is in the background. In VIZEN, pick that window (VIZEN Tab · …) as a source. Minimizing it sends it behind the browser (Windows cannot capture minimized windows). Close it to stop.

popupMirrorFailed.message: The tab could not be mirrored:

mirrorEnded.message: The tab was closed or stopped sharing. You can close this window.

mirrorFailed.message: The tab could not be shown:

mirrorKeepText.message: Chrome pauses this window while it is completely covered by other windows. Allow it once to stay live in VIZEN even behind other windows.
